rules.statement: A lease is considered an incumbrance under the Registration Ordinance (No. 14 of 1891), and therefore, a lessee's rights are not affected by the sale of land under the Partition Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "In any event your appeal cannot succeed. If the lease is an incumbrance, your rights are not affected by the sale,"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Under the Registration Ordinance (No. 14 of 1891), section 16, a lease is an incumbrance.
